title: Phase Planning Bundle Workspace
executionReleaseCondition: WC07 is accepted and the Operator explicitly releases WC08.
purpose: Implement the Phase Planning workspace, separate Phase_Planning and Work_Card_Plan review, and one synchronized bundle disposition without creating Formal Work Cards.

workspace.label: Phase Planning
workspace.layout: Embedded Architect browser with separate Phase_Planning and Work_Card_Plan previews

requiredInputs: Approved Phase_Map and selected phase record
Approved prior phase closeout when applicable
Relevant current repository evidence, risks, constraints, and decisions
reviewMode: Independent document previews with one synchronized Phase Planning disposition
completionRule: Phase Planning completes only when both Phase_Planning and Work_Card_Plan are Approved from the shared disposition action.
workCardPlanBoundary: No Implementer handoffs or execution packets
prohibitedScope: Implementer handoff or execution packet generation
Route tokens, role gates, approval queues, hashes, or execution runs
Provider APIs, DOM automation, or credential extraction
validation: Operator manual validation through the accepted embedded Architect/MCP path
